event_description: Statewide state of emergency for the Blizzard of 2005 (heavy snow), with state and municipal offices closed Monday, January 24.
State of emergency for a weekend storm with heavy rain and flooding, signed October 17 and covering actions since October 15.
Declaration of Disaster Emergency ahead of Hurricane Irene.
Declaration of Disaster Emergency ahead of Hurricane Sandy.
Executive Order 13-02, Declaration of Disaster Emergency for a winter storm with heavy snow, blizzard conditions and hurricane force winds.

Executive Order 03-02, Proclamation of Home Heating Fuel Transportation Emergency for a prolonged period of cold weather and the demand for home heating fuel (continued by 03-03 to 03-07 through February 27, 2003).
Executive Order 10-06, Declaration of Disaster Emergency for severe rainfall causing extensive and in some places historic flooding, and wind from the storm.
